characters.name: Lehi
characters.title: Patriarch & Visionary Prophet
characters.bio: A prophet in Jerusalem who was warned of the city's destruction and led his family across the wilderness and sea to a new promised land. His dream of the tree of life is one of the great visions of scripture.

characters.name: Sariah
characters.title: Matriarch of the Journey
characters.bio: Lehi's wife, who left comfort in Jerusalem for the wilderness. She mourned, questioned, and then testified with surety when her sons returned safely with the brass plates.

characters.name: Nephi
characters.title: Prophet, Founder & Record Keeper
characters.bio: Faithful son of Lehi who obtained the brass plates, built a ship, and founded the Nephite nation. He began the small plates and wrote 'I will go and do the things which the Lord hath commanded.'

characters.name: Sam
characters.title: Faithful Elder Brother
characters.bio: Third son of Lehi who consistently believed Nephi's words and stood with him. Lehi blessed him that his posterity would be numbered with Nephi's.

characters.name: Laman
characters.title: Eldest Son, Rebellious Heir
characters.bio: Lehi's firstborn, who resented leaving Jerusalem and repeatedly rebelled against his father and Nephi. Ancestor and namesake of the Lamanites.

characters.name: Lemuel
characters.title: Second Son, Follower of Laman
characters.bio: Lehi's second son, who 'hearkened unto the words of Laman' rather than choosing for himself. The valley where the family first camped bears his name.

characters.name: Zoram
characters.title: Servant of Laban, Friend of Nephi
characters.bio: Laban's servant who carried the keys to the treasury. After Nephi obtained the plates, Zoram joined the family with an oath of friendship and became a free man in the promised land.

characters.name: Ishmael
characters.title: Father of the Wives
characters.bio: A Jerusalem patriarch whose family joined Lehi's in the wilderness so his daughters could marry Lehi's sons. He died at Nahom, where his daughters mourned bitterly.

characters.name: Laban
characters.title: Keeper of the Brass Plates
characters.bio: A powerful, treacherous elder of Jerusalem who held the brass plates, stole Lehi's property, and sought the brothers' lives. He was delivered into Nephi's hands, 'that a nation might not dwindle in unbelief.'

characters.name: Jacob
characters.title: Prophet Born in the Wilderness
characters.bio: Lehi's fifth son, consecrated a priest and teacher by Nephi. He preserved Zenos's allegory of the olive tree and preached with tender plainness about Christ, pride, and chastity.

characters.name: Joseph
characters.title: Youngest Son of Lehi
characters.bio: Born in the wilderness of Lehi's affliction, and blessed with the promises of his namesake, Joseph of Egypt, concerning a choice seer of the latter days.

characters.name: Enos
characters.title: The Hunter Who Wrestled in Prayer
characters.bio: Son of Jacob whose whole soul hungered while hunting; he prayed all day and into the night until he heard, 'thy sins are forgiven thee,' then spent his life laboring for the Nephites and Lamanites alike.

characters.name: Jarom
characters.title: Keeper of the Small Plates
characters.bio: Son of Enos who wrote briefly, testifying that the plan of salvation had already been written, and kept the record 'for the intent of the benefit of our brethren the Lamanites.'

characters.name: Amaleki
characters.title: Last Voice of the Small Plates
characters.bio: The final writer in Omni, who watched Mosiah discover Zarahemla, delivered the small plates to King Benjamin, and invited all to 'come unto Christ, and partake of his salvation.'

characters.name: Mosiah₁
characters.title: King Who Found Zarahemla
characters.bio: Warned by the Lord to flee the land of Nephi, he led the faithful Nephites down to discover the people of Zarahemla, united the two peoples, and was made their king.

characters.name: King Benjamin
characters.title: The Servant King
characters.bio: A king who labored with his own hands and taught from a tower that 'when ye are in the service of your fellow beings ye are only in the service of your God.' His farewell address brought his whole people into covenant with Christ.

characters.name: King Mosiah₂
characters.title: Seer & Last Nephite King
characters.bio: Son of Benjamin, a seer who translated the Jaredite record with interpreters. He sent his sons to preach to the Lamanites and replaced the monarchy with a reign of elected judges.

characters.name: Zeniff
characters.title: Over-Zealous Colonizer
characters.bio: 'Over-zealous to inherit the land of his fathers,' he led a colony back to the land of Nephi and was ensnared by King Laman's cunning, though he trusted God and defended his people.

characters.name: King Noah
characters.title: The Wicked King
characters.bio: Son of Zeniff who taxed his people a fifth of all they possessed to support his winehouses, elegant towers, and corrupt priests. He burned Abinadi and later suffered death by fire himself, as prophesied.

characters.name: Abinadi
characters.title: Martyr Prophet
characters.bio: A lone prophet who confronted King Noah's court in disguise, expounded the Ten Commandments and Isaiah 53, and testified of Christ with his face shining. Sealed his testimony with his life by fire — and converted Alma.

characters.name: Alma the Elder
characters.title: Priest Turned Founder of the Church
characters.bio: A young priest of Noah who believed Abinadi, fled, and baptized hundreds at the waters of Mormon. He founded the church of Christ among the Nephites and led his people out of bondage.

characters.name: King Limhi
characters.title: King in Bondage
characters.bio: Righteous son of wicked Noah, who ruled his people under Lamanite tribute, welcomed Ammon's expedition, and led his people's night escape to Zarahemla.

characters.name: Gideon
characters.title: Patriot & Defender
characters.bio: The strong man who drove King Noah to the tower, engineered Limhi's escape through the back wall, and in old age was slain by Nehor while defending the church — the valley and city of Gideon honor him.

characters.name: Amulon
characters.title: Chief Priest of Noah
characters.bio: Leader of King Noah's fugitive priests who abducted Lamanite daughters, won favor with the Lamanite king, and cruelly persecuted Alma's people — whose burdens the Lord made light.

characters.name: Ammon (of Zarahemla)
characters.title: Finder of Limhi's People
characters.bio: A strong and mighty descendant of Zarahemla who led sixteen men up to the land of Nephi and found King Limhi's captive colony, then guided their escape home.

characters.name: Ammon
characters.title: Missionary Who Defended the Flocks
characters.bio: A son of Mosiah who renounced the throne to preach among the Lamanites. As King Lamoni's servant he defended the royal flocks at the waters of Sebus, and his service opened thousands of hearts to conversion.

characters.name: Aaron
characters.title: Missionary to the King
characters.bio: Son of Mosiah who suffered prison in Middoni, then taught Lamoni's father — the great king — who prayed, 'I will give away all my sins to know thee.'

characters.name: Omner
characters.title: Missionary Son of Mosiah
characters.bio: One of the four sons of Mosiah who forsook the kingdom to preach fourteen years among the Lamanites.

characters.name: Himni
characters.title: Missionary Son of Mosiah
characters.bio: The fourth son of Mosiah, companion in the fourteen-year Lamanite mission and later a leader of the church in Zarahemla.

characters.name: King Lamoni
characters.title: Converted Lamanite King
characters.bio: King over the land of Ishmael who, astonished by Ammon's faithfulness, was overcome by the Spirit for two days and arose testifying of the Redeemer.

characters.name: Lamoni's Father
characters.title: High King of the Lamanites
characters.bio: King over all the Lamanites who threatened Ammon with the sword, then offered half his kingdom — and finally all his sins — to know God. His conversion opened the whole land to the gospel.

characters.name: Abish
characters.title: Believing Servant Woman
characters.bio: A Lamanite woman converted years earlier by a vision of her father, who ran house to house gathering witnesses when the king's household fell — and raised the queen by the hand.

characters.name: Anti-Nephi-Lehi
characters.title: King of the Converted
characters.bio: Brother of Lamoni, made king over the converted Lamanites who took his name — a people who buried their swords deep in the earth rather than break their covenant of peace.

characters.name: Alma the Younger
characters.title: Chief Judge & High Priest
characters.bio: Once a destroyer of the church, turned by an angel and born of God. He resigned the judgment seat to preach repentance city by city, and his counsel to his sons holds some of scripture's deepest teaching on the Atonement.

characters.name: Amulek
characters.title: Second Witness of Ammonihah
characters.bio: A wealthy man of Ammonihah called by an angel to receive Alma. He left all to testify beside him, silenced Zeezrom, and taught that the Atonement is 'infinite and eternal.'

characters.name: Zeezrom
characters.title: Lawyer Turned Believer
characters.bio: A skilled lawyer of Ammonihah who tried to buy Amulek's testimony with silver, then trembled under conviction, burned with fever for his sins, and was healed by faith to become a missionary himself.

characters.name: Nehor
characters.title: Founder of Priestcraft
characters.bio: The first great dissenter of the reign of the judges, who preached that teachers should be popular and paid, slew the aged Gideon, and died an ignominious death — but his order outlived him.

characters.name: Amlici
characters.title: Would-Be King
characters.bio: A cunning man of Nehor's order who sought to be king, was rejected by the voice of the people, and raised a civil war — falling to Alma sword to sword at the river Sidon.

characters.name: Korihor
characters.title: The Anti-Christ
characters.bio: A preacher who taught that there could be no Christ, demanding a sign until he was struck dumb. He confessed he had always known there was a God, and was trodden down among the Zoramites.

characters.name: Captain Moroni
characters.title: Chief Captain of the Nephites
characters.bio: Commander at age twenty-five who raised the title of liberty — 'In memory of our God, our religion, and freedom.' Mormon wrote that if all men were like Moroni, 'the very powers of hell would have been shaken forever.'

characters.name: Teancum
characters.title: Daring Warrior
characters.bio: A great warrior who twice crept into the enemy camp by night with a javelin — slaying Amalickiah and later Ammoron, giving his own life in the act that ended the long war.

characters.name: Amalickiah
characters.title: Dissenter Who Became Lamanite King
characters.bio: A Nephite dissenter who gained the Lamanite throne by fraud, poison, and murder, and swore to drink Moroni's blood. His rise is scripture's case study in unchecked ambition.

characters.name: Ammoron
characters.title: Brother & Avenger of Amalickiah
characters.bio: Succeeded his murdered brother as Lamanite king and traded defiant epistles with Captain Moroni before falling to Teancum's javelin.

characters.name: Zerahemnah
characters.title: Lamanite Commander
characters.bio: Commander at the battle of the river Sidon who refused Moroni's oath of peace until his army was compassed about — scalped in the attempt, he finally covenanted and departed.

characters.name: Pahoran
characters.title: Chief Judge in Exile
characters.bio: Chief judge driven from Zarahemla by king-men during the war. When Moroni's blistering letter accused him of treason, he answered without offense: 'it mattereth not... I seek not for power, but to pull it down.'

characters.name: Helaman
characters.title: Leader of the 2,060 Stripling Sons
characters.bio: Eldest son of Alma, keeper of the records, and father-captain to two thousand young Ammonite soldiers whose mothers taught them faith — not one of whom perished in battle.

characters.name: Shiblon
characters.title: Steady Son of Alma
characters.bio: Alma's second son, praised for his steadiness and faithfulness — he bore persecution among the Zoramites with patience and later kept the sacred records.

characters.name: Corianton
characters.title: The Son Who Was Called Back
characters.bio: Alma's youngest missionary son, who forsook the ministry for the harlot Isabel. His father's patient correction — on justice, mercy, and resurrection — reclaimed him for the work.

characters.name: Moronihah
characters.title: Son of Captain Moroni
characters.bio: Inherited his father's command, retook half of Zarahemla from the Lamanites, and preached repentance as earnestly as he waged war.

characters.name: Lehi (Commander)
characters.title: Moroni's Right Hand
characters.bio: A Nephite officer 'like unto Moroni,' beloved by the army, who won the day at Riplah's hill and held the city of Mulek's trap shut.

characters.name: Helaman₂
characters.title: Chief Judge, Father of Nephi & Lehi
characters.bio: Son of Helaman who governed justly while Gadianton's band festered in secret. He named his sons Nephi and Lehi so they would remember — and imitate — their first parents' goodness.

characters.name: Nephi (Son of Helaman)
characters.title: Prophet of the Sealing Power
characters.bio: Resigned the judgment seat to preach, revealed a murder from his garden tower, and received the sealing power: 'all things shall be done unto thee according to thy word.' His prayer turned war to famine and famine to rain.

characters.name: Lehi (Son of Helaman)
characters.title: Missionary Encircled by Fire
characters.bio: Nephi's constant companion, imprisoned with him in the land of Nephi where they were encircled by fire and angels ministered — converting three hundred Lamanite witnesses.

characters.name: Samuel the Lamanite
characters.title: Prophet on the Wall
characters.bio: A Lamanite prophet who preached from Zarahemla's wall what the Nephites would not hear — the signs of Christ's birth and death, five years before. Arrows could not touch him.

characters.name: Gadianton
characters.title: Master of the Secret Band
characters.bio: 'Exceedingly expert in his craft of murder and secret work,' he inherited Kishkumen's band and built the covert order of robbers that Mormon says finally proved 'the overthrow... of the people of Nephi.'

characters.name: Kishkumen
characters.title: Assassin of the Judgment Seat
characters.bio: Murdered chief judge Pahoran's son upon the judgment seat and bound his band with secret oaths — slain in the dark on his way to murder Helaman.

characters.name: Lachoneus
characters.title: Governor Who Gathered the People
characters.bio: Chief judge who answered the robber chief's astonishing epistle by gathering all the Nephites — with seven years of provisions — into one defended place, and calling them to repentance first.

characters.name: Gidgiddoni
characters.title: Prophet-General
characters.bio: A great prophet appointed chief captain, who refused to attack first — 'the Lord forbid' — and instead cut off the robbers' retreat until their siege starved itself.

characters.name: Giddianhi
characters.title: Governor of the Robbers
characters.bio: Gadianton chief whose flattering, threatening epistle demanded the Nephites surrender all — his painted, lamb-skinned army fell in the greatest slaughter since Lehi left Jerusalem.

characters.name: Nephi (the Disciple)
characters.title: Chief Disciple of the Risen Lord
characters.bio: Son of Nephi, a prophet of unshaken faith who raised his brother from the dead, and the first of the twelve the Savior called at the temple in Bountiful.

characters.name: Jesus Christ
characters.title: Jehovah — the Son, and Savior of the World
characters.bio: The Only Begotten of the Father in the flesh, and Jehovah of the Old Testament — the God who spoke to Abraham and Moses came to earth as the babe of Bethlehem. He wrought the Atonement, rose the third day, ministered to the Nephites at Bountiful, and opened this dispensation in the Sacred Grove. He and the Father are distinct beings, one in purpose; He is the central figure of all four volumes of scripture.

characters.name: Mormon
characters.title: Prophet-Historian & Abridger
characters.bio: Called at ten to remember, at fifteen visited of the Lord, at sixteen leading armies. He compressed a thousand years of records into the plates that bear his name, mourning a doomed people he never stopped loving.

characters.name: Moroni
characters.title: The Last Nephite
characters.bio: Mormon's son, who wandered alone for decades after his nation's fall — finishing his father's record, abridging Ether, sealing the plates, and promising every reader that God 'will manifest the truth of it unto you.'

characters.name: Jared
characters.title: Founder of the Jaredites
characters.bio: At the great tower he asked his brother to plead that their language not be confounded — and led his people, flocks, and deseret honey-bees toward a land of promise.

characters.name: The Brother of Jared
characters.title: Seer Who Saw the Lord
characters.bio: Mahonri Moriancumer, a man 'highly favored of the Lord,' who molted sixteen small stones and asked God to touch them — and whose faith was so great he could not be kept from within the veil, beholding the premortal Christ.

characters.name: Ether
characters.title: Last Jaredite Prophet
characters.bio: Descendant of kings who lived in a cave and watched by night as his prophecies of destruction were fulfilled — 'whether the Lord will that I be translated... it mattereth not, if it so be that I am saved.'

characters.name: Coriantumr
characters.title: Last Jaredite King
characters.bio: The king who refused Ether's call to repent until 'he began to remember' too late — sole survivor of his people's self-destruction, found later by the people of Zarahemla.

characters.name: Shiz
characters.title: The Relentless Destroyer
characters.bio: Brother of the slain Lib, who swept the earth before him swearing to avenge himself of Coriantumr — his name became a byword of terror in the Jaredites' final madness.

characters.name: Akish
characters.title: Reviver of Secret Oaths
characters.bio: Won the daughter of Jared by dancing intrigue and revived the ancient oaths of Cain — founding the secret combination that destroyed the Jaredite kingdom from within.

characters.name: Isaiah
characters.title: Prophet of the Brass Plates
characters.bio: The great poet-prophet of Jerusalem whose words fill more than twenty chapters of the record. Nephi and the Savior both command: 'great are the words of Isaiah.'

characters.name: Zenos
characters.title: Prophet of the Olive Tree
characters.bio: A prophet known only from the brass plates, whose sweeping allegory of the tame and wild olive trees — preserved in Jacob 5 — maps the whole scattering and gathering of Israel.

characters.name: Zenock
characters.title: Martyred Witness of the Son
characters.bio: A brass-plates prophet who testified that redemption comes through the Son of God, and was stoned for it.

characters.name: Malachi
characters.title: Prophet Quoted by the Savior
characters.bio: The Savior gave the Nephites Malachi's words on the tithes, the messenger, and Elijah — chapters they could not have had, since Malachi prophesied after Lehi left Jerusalem.

characters.name: Moses
characters.title: Lawgiver (Quoted)
characters.bio: The deliverer of Israel, whose law the Nephites kept until it was fulfilled in Christ, and whose prophecy of a prophet 'like unto me' the Savior applied to Himself.

characters.name: Neum
characters.title: Prophet of the Crucifixion
characters.bio: A brass-plates prophet cited by Nephi as testifying that the God of Israel would be crucified.

characters.name: Omni
characters.title: Soldier Record Keeper
characters.bio: A self-described wicked man who nevertheless kept the commandment to preserve the plates, fighting much with the sword to preserve his people.

characters.name: Amaron
characters.title: Witness of a Destruction
characters.bio: Recorded how the more wicked part of the Nephites were destroyed, the Lord sparing the righteous — then handed the plates to his brother.

characters.name: Chemish
characters.title: Briefest of Writers
characters.bio: Wrote a single verse, 'after the manner of my brother' — the shortest contribution in all scripture.

characters.name: Abinadom
characters.title: Soldier of a Silent Age
characters.bio: Confessed he knew of no new revelation or prophecy in his day — an honest window into the small plates' quietest generation.

characters.name: God the Father
characters.title: Elohim — the Eternal Father
characters.bio: The literal Father of the spirits of all mankind and of Jesus Christ in the flesh — a glorified, exalted, embodied Being, distinct from the Son. His own voice introduced the Savior at Bountiful and again in the Sacred Grove: 'This is My Beloved Son. Hear Him!'

characters.name: The Holy Ghost
characters.title: the Comforter — Third Member of the Godhead
characters.bio: A personage of spirit, the Comforter who witnesses of the Father and the Son, sanctifies, and reveals truth 'by the power of the Holy Ghost.' A distinct member of the Godhead, one with the Father and the Son in purpose.

characters.name: Jehovah — the Voice of the Lord
characters.title: the Premortal Jesus Christ, who spoke to the prophets
characters.bio: The Lord who spoke with the prophets before His birth — commanding Lehi to flee, showing the brother of Jared His finger, thundering from Sinai. Latter-day revelation identifies this Jehovah, the God of Israel, as the premortal Jesus Christ Himself.

characters.name: An Angel of the Lord
characters.title: Heavenly Messenger
characters.bio: Angels intervene at turning points of the record — halting Laman's blows, felling Alma and the sons of Mosiah, and teaching King Benjamin the words of his great address.

groups.name: The Nephites
groups.bio: Descendants and followers of Nephi — a covenant people whose thousand-year story of faith, pride, and fall is the record's spine.

groups.name: The Lamanites
groups.bio: Descendants and followers of Laman and Lemuel, often at war with the Nephites — yet promised that the covenants of the Lord would one day flower among their children.

groups.name: People of Zarahemla
groups.bio: Descendants of Mulek, son of King Zedekiah, who left Jerusalem after Lehi and were discovered by Mosiah — merging with the Nephites into one nation.

groups.name: People of Ammon
groups.bio: The converted Lamanites — Anti-Nephi-Lehies — who buried their weapons of war and never took them up again, even to save their own lives.

groups.name: The 2,060 Stripling Warriors
groups.bio: Young sons of the people of Ammon who covenanted to fight so their parents wouldn't break their oath — 'they did not doubt; their mothers knew it.'

groups.name: The Gadianton Robbers
groups.bio: The secret combination of oaths, murder, and plunder that infected both nations — Mormon's warning to our day about corruption that hides in darkness.

groups.name: The Three Nephites
groups.bio: Three of the twelve disciples who, like John the Beloved, asked to tarry and bring souls to Christ until He comes again.

groups.name: The Twelve Disciples
groups.bio: The twelve the risen Lord chose at Bountiful, given power to baptize and to confer the Holy Ghost.

groups.name: The Jaredites
groups.bio: The great nation from the tower of Babel, whose rise and total fall — recorded on twenty-four gold plates — is the record's darkest mirror.

groups.name: The Zoramites
groups.bio: Dissenters who prayed one by one from the Rameumptom tower — yet whose poor in heart received Alma's great sermon on the seed of faith.

groups.name: The Multitude
groups.bio: The gathered people — at Benjamin's tower, at the temple in Bountiful — who heard, believed, and covenanted.

groups.name: The Church of Christ
groups.bio: The community of believers, from the waters of Mormon to the disciples of the risen Lord.

groups.name: The House of Israel
groups.bio: The covenant family — scattered and gathered — to whom Isaiah, Zenos, and the Savior's own words are addressed.

groups.name: You, the Reader
groups.bio: The record's final audience. Mormon and Moroni saw our day and wrote 'as if ye were present.'
